{{Top}}
{{Quote|He had this small sack of coins upon his person when he died.|Pera|<ref name="Star Wars (1977) 7">[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]]</ref>}}
[[File:1000CreditCoin-SWMonopoly.png|thumb|250px|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] credit coin]]
'''Coins''' were pieces of minted metal used as currency. Variaties of coins included:
*[[Credcoin]]s: Coins in [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] issued by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]
*[[Drallish crown]]s: Coins issued on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]
*[[Druggat/Legends|Druggats]]: Coins issued on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]
*[[Peggat/Legends|Peggats]]: [[Hutt/Legends|Hutteese]] coins
*[[Trugut/Legends|Truguts]]: one-fourth of a Peggat
*[[Wupiupi/Legends|Wupiupi]]: one-sixteenth of a Trugut
